runtime.notes: MobSensor boundary behavior was probed with Talk TCP Echo 2 SetProp writes and WriteLn readbacks. The batch compared edge-adjacent values around the previous signed 32-bit samples, restored each path to baseline, and used WriteLn when OSC f callbacks rounded numeric payloads.

restore.notes: The probe captured the baseline before writes, sent a baseline restore after the sampled writes, and verified final WriteLn readback before moving to the next path.

entries.evidenceNote: Fresh Talk TCP Echo 2 WriteLn probe on 2026-05-25 issue #118 confirmed MobSensor.AccelX accepts sampled values from -4294967296 through 4294967296 with pass-through readback and baseline restore. The prior OSC f callback rounded some edge-adjacent samples, so WriteLn readback is used as the Object Tree value check. This is the tested span, not a documented BEYOND limit.

locationContext.notes: The probe used the concrete MobSensor.AccelX mobile app accelerometer path.

restore.notes: The probe captured the baseline before writes, sent a baseline restore after the sampled writes, and verified final WriteLn readback before moving to the next path.
